correctness.rationale: The quartic Jacobian equations yield the explicit smoothness open; adjoint-basis coefficient extraction from F² gives diagonal Cartier entries 2(s+rt),2(t+rs),2(r+st). Three degree-eight-prime-to-three elliptic quotient factors yield the rank and Newton polygon, and Cartier rank yields a-number. Substitution s=-rt proves smooth D_x graph and pairwise axial/transverse intersections. Exclusion of the discriminant quadratic in t, with character sum Σχ(u²−1)=−1, proves #U=(q−2)³−(q−3)² and the claimed exact four formulas for all q=3^n. Standalone pure-Python verifier checks the polynomial identity and exhaustive parameter counts for q=3,9,27 and witness curve point counts over q=9. Enumeration is corroborative only.
